description: SSE stream handling in src/holon_coherence/proxy/steps/sse_tap.py decodes each chunk independently without an incremental UTF-8 decoder or incomplete-line carry buffer and carries a dead self-assignment, while integration tests still hit http://example.com via unittest.TestCase with zero real mitmproxy tflow or local HTTPServer wire tests.
goal: Fix SSE chunk fragmentation in src/holon_coherence/proxy/steps/sse_tap.py (keeping it at most 200 lines): replace chunk.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore') with a per-flow codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-8')(errors='replace') so multi-byte UTF-8 characters split across TCP chunks decode without corruption, maintain a per-flow incomplete-line carry buffer before passing complete lines to translate_openai_sse_chunk_to_gemini (flushing trailing buffered data on empty/final chunk), and remove the dead flow._sse_stream_state = getattr(...) self-assignment. Add offline wire-level tests in tests/test_sse_wire_streaming.py using real mitmproxy.test.tflow.tflow and a local stdlib http.server.HTTPServer verifying fragmented JSON SSE events and split multi-byte UTF-8 sequences across chunk boundaries. Update tests/test_docker_integration.py to replace live http://example.com HTTP requests with a local stdlib HTTPServer target and migrate unittest.TestCase subclasses to plain pytest functions. Use zero docstrings and zero comments in all modified or added Python files so tests/test_repo_self_doc.py passes. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Chunked TCP delivery splits multi-byte UTF-8 sequences and JSON SSE lines; incremental decoding, line buffering, and offline wire tests catch regressions deterministically without external network dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Fragmented SSE JSON lines and split multi-byte UTF-8 code points across arbitrary chunk boundaries translate and tap with zero dropped events or decode errors.
Wire tests using mitmproxy.test.tflow and local HTTPServer pass offline with uv run pytest.
Zero unittest.TestCase subclasses and zero harness references remain in holon-coherence.
